blocks.title: Acceptance testing
blocks.text: Acceptance testing testing ki aakhri satah hai, jo yeh tay karne ke liye hoti hai ke software release ke liye tayyar hai ya nahi. Yeh aksar aakhri users ya clients karte hain ta ke yaqeeni ho ke software un ki tawaqqoaat aur requirements poori kare.

Yeh rasmi ya ghair rasmi ho sakti hai aur aam taur par haqeeqi istemal ki naqal karne wale manzar (scenarios) le kar software ki usability, reliability aur performance jaanchti hai. Kyunke aksar aakhri users ise karte hain, acceptance testing ko kabhi User Acceptance Testing (UAT) kehte hain (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Acceptance testing aam taur par kaun karta hai, aur yeh kya tay karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Aakhri users ya clients; yeh tay karti hai ke software un ki zarooratein poori karta aur release ke liye tayyar hai ya nahi.

items: Acceptance testing: aakhri satah; users ya clients haqeeqi manzar jaanch kar tay karte hain ke software tayyar hai (UAT).
